title: Shashlik
subtitle: Pork Kebab
steps: Thinly slice the tomatoes and onions into a very large bowl.
Add the bay leaves, salt, pepper, crushed red pepper, and beer. Mix by hand, squeezing the tomatoes and onions to release their juices.
Trim external fat and silverskin from the pork, then cut into 1–1.5-inch cubes.
Mix the pork into the marinade. Transfer to a container or large ziplock bags and marinate for 24 hours.
Grill over hot coals at medium-high heat, turning every 30 seconds, until golden brown and the pork registers 145°F on a thermometer.
